config.autotorch.nearbyAutoTorch.enabled:
Nearby auto lighting
Places a block at valid dark spots within about 2 blocks of the player.
config.autotorch.nearbyAutoTorch.lightTh:
Nearby lighting light threshold
A block is placed only where the light level is below this value.
config.autotorch.nearbyAutoTorch.include:
Nearby lighting includes sky light
true uses the higher of block light and sky light; false checks block light only.
config.autotorch.nearbyAutoTorch.scanInt:
Nearby lighting scan interval
In ticks.
config.autotorch.nearbyAutoTorch.darkCon:
Nearby lighting dark confirm time
How long a candidate spot must stay dark, in ticks.
config.autotorch.nearbyAutoTorch.retryDe:
Nearby lighting retry delay
Wait before retrying the same spot, in ticks.
config.autotorch.nearbyAutoTorch.horizon:
Nearby lighting horizontal radius
The vertical range is fixed to -2 through +1.
config.autotorch.nearbyAutoTorch.item:
Nearby lighting placement item
A placeable block item ID.
config.autotorch.lightOverlay.enabled:
Light overlay
Shows light levels and spawn risks near the camera.
config.autotorch.lightOverlay.renderThro:
Light overlay see-through
Shows light markers through blocks.
config.autotorch.lightOverlay.numberRota:
Rotate light numbers with view
When false, numbers keep a fixed orientation.
config.autotorch.lightOverlay.horizontal:
Light overlay horizontal radius
Centered on the camera; larger values noticeably increase the per-frame scan cost.
config.autotorch.lightOverlay.downRange:
Light overlay down range
Blocks scanned below the camera; the sum with the up range cannot exceed 64.
config.autotorch.lightOverlay.upRange:
Light overlay up range
Blocks scanned above the camera; the sum with the down range cannot exceed 64.
config.autotorch.lightOverlay.mode:
Light overlay mode
0 = X marks, 1 = numbers, 2 = boxed numbers.
config.autotorch.lightOverlay.detectSlim:
Slime detection
Marks valid slime spawn spots in purple.
config.autotorch.lightOverlay.detectDrow:
Drowned detection
Marks valid drowned spawn spots in cyan; water columns are checked every frame.
config.autotorch.lightOverlay.scanBudget:
Light overlay scan budget
Maximum blocks scanned per tick.
config.autotorch.lightOverlay.refreshInt:
Light overlay refresh interval
How often cached positions are rechecked, in ticks.
config.autotorch.lightOverlay.drownedBud:
Drowned occlusion budget
Maximum blocks checked per frame; unused on 26.1.2 and earlier.
config.autotorch.lightOverlay.nearLineWi:
Light marker near line width
Line width of markers close to the camera.
config.autotorch.lightOverlay.farLineWid:
Light marker far line width
Minimum line width of distant markers.
config.autotorch.lightOverlay.alwaysRisk:
Always-danger marker color
Six-digit hexadecimal RGB.
config.autotorch.lightOverlay.nightRiskC:
Night-risk marker color
Six-digit hexadecimal RGB.
config.autotorch.lightOverlay.safeColor:
Safe marker color
Six-digit hexadecimal RGB.
config.autotorch.lightOverlay.slimeColor:
Slime marker color
Six-digit hexadecimal RGB.
config.autotorch.lightOverlay.drownedCol:
Drowned marker color
Six-digit hexadecimal RGB.
config.autotorch.selectionOverlay.enable:
Show selections
Draws selection boxes for lighting areas and exclusions.
config.autotorch.selectionOverlay.linesO:
Selection outlines only
true draws outlines only; false fills faces with a translucent color.
config.autotorch.selectionOverlay.smooth:
Smooth sphere selection
Finer drawing at a higher cost.
config.autotorch.selectionOverlay.nearLi:
Selection near line width
Shared by the lighting area and exclusions.
config.autotorch.selectionOverlay.farLin:
Selection far line width
Minimum line width of distant selections.
config.autotorch.selectionOverlay.draftC:
Draft selection color
Six-digit hexadecimal RGB.
config.autotorch.selectionOverlay.mainCo:
Lighting area color
Six-digit hexadecimal RGB.
config.autotorch.selectionOverlay.select:
Enable selection tool
Left/right click with the tool sets points A and B; when disabled the item keeps vanilla breaking and interaction, and coordinates can still be entered in the panel.
config.autotorch.selectionOverlay.symbol:
Symbol buttons
Uses symbols for the convert and swap buttons in the area lighting screen; text is shown when disabled.
config.autotorch.lightingTaskDefaults.ma:
Default block limit
Default for new tasks; 0 means unlimited, but the server limit limits.maxTorchesPerTask still applies.
config.autotorch.lightingTaskDefaults.mi:
Default block spacing
3D straight-line distance between block coordinates; at 8, aligned blocks have 7 blocks between them.
config.autotorch.lightingTaskDefaults.li:
Default light threshold
Processes positions whose block light is at or below this value; 0 means block light 0 only.
config.autotorch.lightingTaskDefaults.in:
Default include sky light
Whether new tasks include positions with sky light; when disabled only positions without sky light are processed.
config.autotorch.lightingTaskDefaults.cr:
Creative consumes items
Whether creative mode consumes the selected placement item from the inventory in new tasks by default.
config.autotorch.lightingTaskDefaults.su:
Survival consumes items
Whether survival mode consumes the selected placement item from the inventory in new tasks by default; singleplayer uses this value, multiplayer follows gameplay.survivalConsumesTorches on the server.
config.autotorch.lightingTaskDefaults.pr:
Task progress sync interval
In ticks.
config.autotorch.lightingTaskDefaults.pl:
Task placement item
A placeable block item ID.
config.autotorch.lightingTask.enabled:
Enable interval tasks
Whether the server allows interval auto lighting tasks; disabling it rejects new tasks and stops running ones
config.autotorch.limits.maxBoxAxisLength:
Maximum box axis length
Maximum side length the server allows; raising it notably increases scanning and selection data size
config.autotorch.limits.maxSphereRadius:
Maximum sphere radius
Maximum radius the server allows; raising it notably increases the scan volume of a task
config.autotorch.limits.maxExclusions:
Maximum exclusions
Number of exclusions a single task may submit; 0 disallows exclusions
config.autotorch.limits.maxTorchesPerTas:
Maximum blocks per task
Hard server-side cap; even when the client sets 0 (unlimited), placement never exceeds this value
config.autotorch.limits.allowUnlimitedTo:
Allow unlimited blocks
Whether the client may set the block limit to 0 (unlimited); when disabled the client must give a concrete limit, still capped by limits.maxTorchesPerTask
config.autotorch.limits.minSpacing:
Minimum block spacing
Smallest spacing the server allows clients to set; larger values spread blocks out and may fail to reach the light target
It cannot exceed the maximum; if hand-edited in reverse the smaller value is used as the minimum
config.autotorch.limits.maxSpacing:
Maximum block spacing
Largest spacing the server allows clients to set
It cannot be below the minimum; if hand-edited in reverse the larger value is used as the maximum
config.autotorch.limits.maxConcurrentTas:
Maximum concurrent tasks
Interval tasks that may run server-wide at once; raising it multiplies scanning and block update load
config.autotorch.gameplay.survivalConsum:
Survival consumes items
Whether survival tasks must consume the selected placement item from the player's inventory; when disabled survival can place the selected blocks from nothing
config.autotorch.performance.scanBudgetP:
Per-task scan budget
Maximum blocks a single task may scan per tick; raising it also increases block update and light calculation load
config.autotorch.performance.placeBudget:
Per-task place budget
Maximum blocks a single task may place per tick; raising it increases block update and network sync pressure
config.autotorch.performance.globalScanB:
Global scan budget
Maximum blocks all tasks together may scan per tick; with the per-task budget it bounds server load
config.autotorch.performance.globalPlace:
Global place budget
Maximum blocks all tasks together may place per tick; with the per-task budget it bounds server load
config.autotorch.performance.randomPlace:
Placement attempts
Maximum attempts to find a placeable spot for each dark position; raising it makes placement easier but costs more time per placement
